import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    values = []
    idx = 1
    for _ in range(n):
        x = int(data[idx])
        idx += 1
        values.append(x)
        values.sort()
    print(values[len(values) // 2])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
